description.value:
Requirement You are wielding two firearms.

Duration constant

Any single action you take that makes one ranged Strike may instead make one with each firearm against the same target. The second Strike does not count toward your multiple attack penalty, and if both hit, combine their damage into a single instance before applying resistances.

cinderfall.incomplete: this doesn't just add a modifier, it recomposes how a Strike action itself resolves (two attack rolls, combined damage instance). No rule element composes two separate Strikes into one damage instance for resistance purposes. Same shape as Gunslinger's own Two-Weapon Fusillade (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-14/two-weapon-fusillade.json, rules: []) — cited for shape only, per's override. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
